table.name: circuits
table.purpose: Reference table of Formula 1 racing circuits (venues where races are held), one row per circuit, referenced by the races table.

alt.name: alt
alt.description: Altitude of the circuit above sea level, in metres (e.g. Mexico City is high, ~2200). Plausible given the neighbouring geographic columns (lat, lng, location), though the column's declared boolean role does not fit this reading; another possibility is a flag of some kind, but no evidence supports that.

circuitId.name: circuitId
circuitId.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each circuit. Referenced by races.circuitId to link races to their venue.

circuitRef.name: circuitRef
circuitRef.description: Unique short slug/code identifying each circuit (e.g. 'ricard', 'zolder', 'interlagos'), used as a stable textual reference key.

country.name: country
country.description: Country where the circuit is located (e.g. France, USA, UK).

lat.name: lat
lat.description: Latitude of the circuit's geographic location in decimal degrees (range -34.9 to 57.3, consistent with worldwide circuit locations).

lng.name: lng
lng.description: Longitude of the circuit's geographic location in decimal degrees (range -118.2 to 138.9, consistent with worldwide circuit locations).

location.name: location
location.description: Town, city or locality where the circuit is situated (e.g. Le Castellet, Heusden-Zolder, Silverstone).

name.name: name
name.description: Full official name of the circuit (e.g. 'Circuit Paul Ricard', 'Silverstone Circuit').

url.name: url
url.description: Wikipedia URL for the circuit's article; one unique URL per circuit.

table.name: constructorResults
table.purpose: Per-race championship points earned by each constructor (Formula 1). One row per constructor per race, recording the points that constructor scored in that race (used to build constructor standings).

constructorId.name: constructorId
constructorId.description: Identifier of the constructor (team) that scored the points; references constructors.constructorId.

constructorResultsId.name: constructorResultsId
constructorResultsId.description: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for the constructor-per-race points record.

points.name: points
points.description: Championship points scored by the constructor in that race (0–66; larger values reflect combined points of both cars and, in some eras, different points systems).

raceId.name: raceId
raceId.description: Identifier of the race in which the points were scored; references races.raceId.

status.name: status
status.description: Almost always null; the only observed value is 'D', which likely marks a disqualified constructor result. The exact code meaning is not confirmed by other evidence.

table.name: constructorStandings
table.purpose: Formula 1 constructors' (teams') championship standings after each race: cumulative points, championship position, and win count per constructor per race (the standard Ergast F1 database schema).

constructorId.name: constructorId
constructorId.description: Identifier of the constructor (team); references constructors.constructorId.

constructorStandingsId.name: constructorStandingsId
constructorStandingsId.description: Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each standings row.

points.name: points
points.description: Cumulative championship points accumulated by the constructor up to and including that race (max 765, half points like 27.5 reflect shortened-race point splits).

position.name: position
position.description: Constructor's championship standing position (rank) after that race, 1 = leading the championship.

positionText.name: positionText
positionText.description: Position rendered as text; in this dataset it always equals the numeric position (in other F1 datasets it can hold 'E' for excluded, but no such values appear here).

raceId.name: raceId
raceId.description: Identifier of the race after which the standings were computed; references races.raceId.

wins.name: wins
wins.description: Cumulative number of race wins by the constructor up to and including that race.

table.name: constructors
table.purpose: Formula 1 constructors (racing teams/car builders). One row per constructor, referenced by results, qualifying, constructor results and standings. This is the Ergast F1 database's constructors table.

constructorId.name: constructor_id
constructorId.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each constructor. Referenced by results, constructorResults, constructorStandings and qualifying.

constructorRef.name: constructor_ref
constructorRef.description: Unique short slug/code identifying the constructor (e.g. 'tyrrell', 'zakspeed'), likely used as a stable external reference key.

name.name: name
name.description: Full display name of the constructor/team (e.g. 'Alfa Romeo', 'Brabham-Repco').

nationality.name: nationality
nationality.description: Country/nationality of the constructor (e.g. British, American, Italian).

url.name: url
url.description: Wikipedia URL for the constructor's page. Not unique because some constructors (e.g. Cooper variants) share the same Wikipedia article.

table.name: driverStandings
table.purpose: Formula 1 driver championship standings snapshot after each race: one row per driver per race, showing cumulative points, championship position, and win count at that point in the season.

driverId.name: driverId
driverId.description: Identifier of the driver this standing belongs to; references drivers.driverId.

driverStandingsId.name: driverStandingsId
driverStandingsId.description: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for each standings row.

points.name: points
points.description: Cumulative championship points the driver had accumulated in the season up to and including this race (max 397, half points like 27.5 occur due to shared points or shortened races).

position.name: position
position.description: Driver's championship standing position (rank) after the given race; 1 = championship leader.

positionText.name: positionText
positionText.description: Text representation of the championship position; in this dataset it duplicates the numeric position (values like 'D' for disqualified may exist elsewhere but are not observed here).

raceId.name: raceId
raceId.description: Identifier of the race after which this standings snapshot applies; references races.raceId.

wins.name: wins
wins.description: Number of race wins the driver had accumulated in the season up to and including this race.

table.name: drivers
table.purpose: Formula 1 drivers reference table: one row per driver (historical and current), with personal details and links to race results, standings, lap times, pit stops and qualifying.

code.name: driver code
code.description: Three-letter driver abbreviation (e.g. VER, ROS, SAI) used in timing screens and TV graphics. Mostly null because permanent codes were only introduced in recent seasons.

dob.name: date of birth
dob.description: Driver's date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). Range 1896-1998 covers the full history of the sport.

driverId.name: driver ID
driverId.description: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for each driver, referenced by results, driverStandings, pitStops, lapTimes and qualifying.

driverRef.name: driver reference slug
driverRef.description: Unique human-readable slug (typically surname-based, e.g. 'gilles_villeneuve') used as a stable reference key in the Ergast-style API.

nationality.name: nationality
nationality.description: Driver's nationality as an adjective (British, American, Italian, ...), 41 distinct values including hyphenated dual nationalities.

number.name: permanent car number
number.description: Driver's permanent race number (2-99) introduced in 2014; null for drivers who raced before permanent numbering.

url.name: Wikipedia URL
url.description: Link to the driver's Wikipedia page; unique per driver.

table.name: lapTimes
table.purpose: Per-lap timing data for each driver in each race (Formula 1): one row per driver per lap of a race, with lap time and the driver's race position at the end of that lap. Composite key of (raceId, driverId, lap).

driverId.name: driverId
driverId.description: Identifier of the driver who recorded the lap; references drivers.driverId (many-to-one).

lap.name: lap
lap.description: Lap number within the race, starting at 1 (max observed 78, e.g. number of laps completed so far). Part of the row's composite key with raceId and driverId.

milliseconds.name: milliseconds
milliseconds.description: Lap time in milliseconds (e.g. 91255 ms = 1:31.255, matching the time column).

position.name: position
position.description: The driver's race position (1–24) at the end of that lap; roughly equal counts per position reflect one driver per position per lap.

raceId.name: raceId
raceId.description: Identifier of the race; references races.raceId (many-to-one).

time.name: time
time.description: Lap time formatted as m:ss.mmm (e.g. '1:31.255'), the human-readable form of milliseconds.

table.name: pitStops
table.purpose: Formula 1 pit stop records: one row per pit stop made by a driver during a race, giving the lap, stop number, local time of day, and stationary duration of the stop.

driverId.name: driverId
driverId.description: Identifier of the driver making the pit stop; references drivers.driverId (many-to-one).

duration.name: duration
duration.description: Pit stop duration in seconds, stored as text with millisecond precision (e.g. '24.719' = 24.719 s); string form of milliseconds.

lap.name: lap
lap.description: Lap number of the race on which the pit stop occurred (1–74).

milliseconds.name: milliseconds
milliseconds.description: Pit stop duration in milliseconds (e.g. 30888 ms = 30.888 s); numeric counterpart of duration. Max ~2011 s likely reflects an anomalous/very long stop.

raceId.name: raceId
raceId.description: Identifier of the race in which the pit stop occurred; references races.raceId (many-to-one).

stop.name: stop
stop.description: Sequential pit stop number for that driver within the race (1st stop, 2nd stop, etc.; 1–6).

time.name: time
time.description: Local time of day (HH:MM:SS) at which the pit stop occurred.

table.name: qualifying
table.purpose: Formula 1 qualifying results: one row per driver per race, recording the driver's car number, constructor, final qualifying position, and lap times in each qualifying segment (Q1, Q2, Q3).

constructorId.name: constructorId
constructorId.description: Foreign key to constructors.constructorId; the team the driver was driving for in this qualifying session.

driverId.name: driverId
driverId.description: Foreign key to drivers.driverId; the driver who took part in this qualifying session.

number.name: number
number.description: The driver's car/race number used in that session (0-99, e.g. 7, 18).

position.name: position
position.description: Final qualifying position (grid slot) achieved by the driver in that race's qualifying, 1 = pole sitter; up to 28.

q1.name: q1
q1.description: Driver's best lap time in the Q1 qualifying segment, formatted as m:ss.mmm. Null/empty if the driver set no Q1 time.

q2.name: q2
q2.description: Driver's best lap time in the Q2 qualifying segment (m:ss.mmm). Null for drivers eliminated after Q1 (~51.5% null rate).

q3.name: q3
q3.description: Driver's best lap time in the Q3 qualifying segment (m:ss.mmm). Null for drivers eliminated after Q1/Q2 (~71% null rate).

qualifyId.name: qualifyId
qualifyId.description: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for each qualifying result row.

raceId.name: raceId
raceId.description: Foreign key to races.raceId; the race (round) this qualifying session belongs to.

table.name: races
table.purpose: One row per Formula 1 Grand Prix race (1950–2017): its season, round number, circuit, date, start time, and Wikipedia link. Referenced by results, standings, qualifying, lap times, and pit stops.

circuitId.name: circuitId
circuitId.description: Foreign key to circuits.circuitId, the venue where the race was held.

date.name: date
date.description: Date the race took place (1950-05-13 to 2017-11-26).

name.name: name
name.description: Name of the Grand Prix, e.g. 'British Grand Prix', 'Italian Grand Prix'.

raceId.name: raceId
raceId.description: Primary key; unique identifier of the race, referenced by results, qualifying, lapTimes, pitStops, driverStandings, constructorStandings, constructorResults.

round.name: round
round.description: Round number of the race within its championship season (1–21).

time.name: time
time.description: Scheduled local start time of the race in HH:MM:SS format; null for 75% of rows (mostly older races where start time is unknown).

url.name: url
url.description: Wikipedia article URL for the specific race edition (e.g. 1950_Belgian_Grand_Prix).

year.name: year
year.description: Championship season year the race belongs to (1950–2017).

table.name: results
table.purpose: Race results for Formula 1 Grands Prix: one row per driver per race, recording grid position, finishing position, points, laps, times, fastest-lap data and finishing status. This is the standard Ergast F1 database 'results' table.

constructorId.name: constructorId
constructorId.description: Identifier of the constructor (team) the driver raced for; references constructors.constructorId.

driverId.name: driverId
driverId.description: Identifier of the driver; references drivers.driverId.

fastestLap.name: fastestLap
fastestLap.description: Lap number on which the driver's fastest lap of the race was set (2-78). Null for races before this data was recorded (~2004) or when not applicable.

fastestLapSpeed.name: fastestLapSpeed
fastestLapSpeed.description: Average speed of the driver's fastest lap, in km/h (range ~89.5-257.3). Stored as VARCHAR.

fastestLapTime.name: fastestLapTime
fastestLapTime.description: Time of the driver's fastest lap, formatted m:ss.mmm (e.g. 1:21.134).

grid.name: grid
grid.description: Starting grid position of the driver (1 = pole). 0 indicates starting from the pit lane or no recorded grid position.

laps.name: laps
laps.description: Number of laps completed by the driver in the race; 0 for drivers who did not start.

milliseconds.name: milliseconds
milliseconds.description: Total race time for classified finishers, in milliseconds (e.g. 6076447 ≈ 1h41m). Null for non-finishers.

number.name: number
number.description: Car/driver number used in that race (0-208).

points.name: points
points.description: Championship points scored by the driver for this race result (0-50; fractional values reflect shared points or fastest-lap rules).

position.name: position
position.description: Official finishing position (1 = winner) for classified finishers; null for non-classified results (DNF, DSQ, etc.).

positionOrder.name: positionOrder
positionOrder.description: Finishing order of all entries in the race, always populated (1 = first); unlike 'position', it ranks non-finishers too.

positionText.name: positionText
positionText.description: Finishing position as text: a number for classified finishers, or a code such as 'R' (retired) and 'F' for non-finishers.

raceId.name: raceId
raceId.description: Identifier of the race (Grand Prix); references races.raceId.

rank.name: rank
rank.description: Rank of the driver's fastest lap within the race (1 = fastest lap of the race, up to 24). Null when fastest-lap data is absent.

resultId.name: resultId
resultId.description: Primary key; unique identifier of the race-result row.

statusId.name: statusId
statusId.description: Identifier of the finishing status (e.g. finished, retired, accident); references status.statusId.

time.name: time
time.description: Gap to the race winner as text, e.g. '+24.160' (seconds) or '+8:22.19' (minutes:seconds); null for the winner and non-finishers.

table.name: seasons
table.purpose: One row per Formula One championship season (1950-2017), linking each season year to its Wikipedia article. This is a small dimension/lookup table in a Formula One database (races, drivers, constructors, results, etc.).

url.name: wikipedia_url
url.description: URL of the Wikipedia article for that season's Formula One championship (e.g. http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1950_Formula_One_season). One unique URL per season.

year.name: season_year
year.description: Calendar year of the Formula One championship season. Unique, one row per year, ranging 1950-2017 (68 seasons). Likely the table's primary key despite not being flagged.

table.name: status
table.purpose: Lookup table of race finish/dnf statuses for Formula 1 results (e.g. finished, +N laps, mechanical failure reasons). Referenced by results.statusId.

status.name: status_label
status.description: Human-readable race status: either a finishing classification relative to the winner ('+N Laps') or the reason a driver did not finish (e.g. 'Engine', 'Out of fuel', 'Fuel rig', 'Water pipe', 'Exhaust').

statusId.name: status_id
statusId.description: Primary key of the status lookup table; surrogate integer identifier for each distinct status label. Referenced by results.statusId to classify each race result.
